accessToken.bearerFormat: Access token; issuer/provider and device binding pending A02
accessToken.description: Verify identity and active membership, then enforce each operation scope and object grant. Documentation is not enforcement.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped to authenticated actor/operation; retries must use identical request bytes. Conflict returns 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag for expected policy version. Missing or malformed is 400; stale is 412.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque token bound to tenant, user, device/view and snapshot; expired tokens return 410.

Error400.description: Invalid request shape, encoding or semantic fields.

Error403.description: Authenticated actor lacks the required action.

Error409.description: Idempotency, device/key snapshot or delivery-state conflict.

Error410.description: Cursor no longer retained; restart scoped snapshot.

Error413.description: Encoded or decoded request size limit exceeded.

Error503.description: Transient inability to perform the operation.

Error415.description: Unsupported media type or content encoding.

Address.description: Verified delivery alias; normalization/reassignment require A02 review. Not an authorization key.

Profile.description: Syntactic identifier only. No production profile is approved; server admission requires a reviewed allowlist.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem with safe stable code. No private resource details or internal exception text.

public_key_package.description: Unpadded canonical base64url. Semantic validation must decode strictly and enforce byte limits.

DeviceRequest.description: Owner enrollment requires step-up and proof of possession using the reviewed E02 credential design, not just these JSON fields.

public_key_package.description: Unpadded canonical base64url. Semantic validation must decode strictly and enforce byte limits.

DirectoryEntry.description: Authorized public projection. Clients still need independent first-contact/key-change verification.

ciphertext.description: Unpadded canonical base64url. Semantic validation must decode strictly and enforce byte limits.

SubmitMessage.description: Sender identity and envelope ID are server-derived. Validate expiry against server admission time and recipient snapshot under current policy. Proposed wire shape, not an approved crypto adapter.

Envelope.description: Immutable server-derived identity plus submitted sealed data. Server metadata is not retrospectively authenticated sender data.

AckRequest.description: Device ID must match authenticated active credential and addressed delivery. Ack claims durable sealed-record storage, not decryption or reading.
